title: Trillion-dollar computing power, held up by a single tantalum capacitor
description: In this computing delivery chain, a shortage of chips and copper foil delays construction. A shortage of transformers delays powering up after servers are moved into the park. But a shortage of tantalum capacitors delays the final step before machines roll off the production line. It is not that conspicuous, yet it can leave hundreds of complete machines stuck on the production line.
